spec.title: Omni: Scheduler State
spec.description: Per-replica running / waiting request gauges.

spec.title: Omni: Token Throughput
spec.description: Prompt / generation tokens per replica (0 for diffusion).

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:prompt_tokens_total{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:generation_tokens_total{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: Omni: Finish Reason
spec.description: Completed requests by finished_reason, per replica.

spec.expr: sum by (finished_reason, model_name, replica) (increase(vllm_omni:requests_success_total{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: Omni: E2E Request Latency
spec.description: End-to-end request latency per replica. Average and P90 per replica (P50/P95/P99 omitted: max_num_seqs=1).

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:e2e_request_latency_s_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: Omni Diffusion: DiT Exec
spec.description: DiT forward pass execution time per request. Average and P90 per replica (P50/P95/P99 omitted: max_num_seqs=1).

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_s_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: Omni Diffusion: Exec Per Step
spec.description: DiT forward time per denoising step. Average and P90 per replica (P50/P95/P99 omitted: max_num_seqs=1).

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_per_step_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_per_step_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_per_step_s_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: Omni Diffusion: Preprocess
spec.description: Diffusion input preprocessing time per request. Average and P90 per replica (P50/P95/P99 omitted: max_num_seqs=1).

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_preprocess_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_preprocess_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_preprocess_s_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: Omni Diffusion: Postprocess
spec.description: Diffusion output postprocess (VAE decode) time per request. Average and P90 per replica (P50/P95/P99 omitted: max_num_seqs=1).

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_postprocess_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_postprocess_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_postprocess_s_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: Omni Diffusion: Timing Breakdown (avg)
spec.description: Average preprocess / DiT exec / postprocess in one view.

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_preprocess_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_preprocess_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_exec_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_postprocess_s_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm_omni:diffusion_postprocess_s_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM wrap: Token Throughput
spec.description: Upstream vllm:* tokens, labeled by Omni stage + replica. Empty when the pipeline has no AR/LLM stage.

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

sum by (model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM wrap: Time To First Token
spec.description: Upstream TTFT with Omni {stage, replica} labels.

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: vLLM wrap: E2E Request Latency
spec.description: Upstream per-engine e2e (one AR stage), not the Omni pipeline e2e.

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, stage, replica) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$omni_model_name", experiment_name=~"$experiment_name", project=~"$project", stage=~"$stage", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.description: Upstream running / waiting / swapped, labeled by stage + replica.
